title: The Elementor Website Builder – More Than Just a Page Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive…
description: The Elementor Website Builder plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 4.0.5 has a vulnerability that allows authenticated users with Contributor-level access or higher to access sensitive information. This occurs via the /wp-json/elementor/v1/user REST endpoint, exposing emails, password hashes, and usernames of all WordPress users.
